## About
B Auto Parts sells recycled auto parts out of our yard on Madison Road in East St. Louis. Charlie Barzoff owns the place. Chad Welch and Charlie work sales, and Sandy Barzoff and Samantha Welch handle accounting.
We're an ARA Gold Seal member, and we're rated 4.1 from 152 Google reviews. Tell us what you need and we'll check if it's on the shelf.

## Services
- Recycled parts: Used parts pulled from salvage vehicles and graded on the ARA parts grading system.
- Request a Salvage Bid: Ask us for a salvage bid.
- Sell My Car: Have a car you want to get rid of? Talk to us about selling it.

## FAQ
Q: When are you open?
A: 8:00 am to 5:00 pm Monday through Friday, and 8:00 am to 12:00 pm Saturday. Closed Sunday.

Q: Where are you?
A: We're on Madison Road in East St. Louis, just minutes from downtown St. Louis.

Q: Do you have a toll-free number?
A: Yes. Call us toll free at 800-851-3157.

Q: How do I hear about new stock?
A: Sign up for our newsletter. Members get an email when new items come in and hear about special promotions first.

## What customers say
- "I went to B Auto Parts looking for a door that nobody else in the St. Louis or Illinois area seemed to have, and they had exactly what I needed in stock. Chad and the owner, Charlie, were incredibly friendly, professional, and helpful throughout the entire process.

They went above and beyond by helping me locate the correct door, answering all my questions, and even wrapping it up carefully so I could transport it safely without any damage.

It's hard to find customer service like that these days. If you're looking for quality parts and people who genuinely care about helping their customers, I highly recommend B Auto Parts. I'll definitely be doing business with them again." (Michael Marcus, 5/5)
